_doc: Canon placemarks from the two Great-War-era folders of the Fallout Universe KML (source-maps/fallout-universe-map.kml, snapshot 2026-07-26), imported by docs/changes/map-timeline/trace/kml_canon_placemarks.py and sorted into typed channels. Coordinates are the KML's own lon/lat - which the owner made canonical for site geography - through the shipped atlas-georef.json, so these sit in the same frame as the pins, the regions and the blast sites. The 61 crater and detonation records are NOT here: they ship separately as atlas-blast-sites.json, and the expression that excludes them is the same one that selects them there. Points only; the tool cannot emit a polygon.
sourceFolders: Pre-Great War conflicts, major events, and military-related locations
